title: Theory 3
learning_outcomes_intro: After successfully completing the module, students will be able to

items: know the fundamentals of user experience design.
understand the fundamental theories and best practices of narrative-, level- and mission-design.
apply their knowledge and comprehension to design experiences within a predesigned framework.
create innovative ways of narrative- and mission design.
evaluate their designs with e.g., user tests.
